name: Line Grid
description: Line Grid v0.5.0 for Komari RPC2: responsive infrastructure views, latency, traffic history, resources, billing metadata, GeoIP controls and incremental live updates. Traffic-cycle management is delegated to the backend.
author: line-grid theme contributors / DeterminantMatrix

help.en: First, Keep, or Last. Within each group nodes follow backend weight order.
help.zh-CN: First / Keep / Last；组内按后端 weight 顺序。

help.en: Low uses simplified continents and the lowest refresh rate; Medium keeps detailed land with reduced coastline sampling; High uses the full coastline and densest links.
help.zh-CN: 低：简化大陆+最低刷新率；中：完整大陆但降低海岸线采样与连线密度；高：完整海岸线、最密连线和最高刷新率。

name.zh-CN: 启用 GeoIP / ASN 识别

help.en: Opt-in. Full node IPs visible to your current account are sent to public GeoIP providers.
help.zh-CN: 隐私敏感，默认关闭。开启后会将当前账号可见的完整公网节点 IP 发送给公共 GeoIP 服务。

help.en: Primary public GeoIP service. Only used when GeoIP / ASN enrichment is enabled.
help.zh-CN: GeoIP / ASN 识别开启后使用的首选公共服务。

name.en: Try other GeoIP providers on failure
name.zh-CN: GeoIP 失败时尝试其他服务商

help.en: Off by default. When enabled, failed lookups may be retried with another configured public provider.
help.zh-CN: 默认关闭。开启后首选服务失败时，才会继续尝试其他公共 GeoIP 服务。
